From a Voat vs. Reddit point of view...

Pros:

  • Far less censorship
  • Nicer layout (imo)
  • More transparent and less prone to mod abuse
  • More liberal in permitted content
  • Innovative features not present on Reddit
  • Newer and smaller community that you can have a large impact on in its early days

Cons:

  • Less content
  • Not as customisable (fewer settings)
  • Fewer features overall
  • Less developed and more prone to attacks/bugs
  • Fewer add-ons and apps
I've also noticed the majority of the users are a lot more serious in their posted content and comments, which could be viewed as either a pro or a con depending on your disposition.
